card.summary: None under this name: every request is redirected to a mover notice, 'SceneNZBs is now called Treasure Maps. You can find us at our new address.'

free_tier.stated: None under this name: every request is redirected to a mover notice, 'SceneNZBs is now called Treasure Maps. You can find us at our new address.'

retention.stated: not applicable: the name no longer serves an index

egress.terms: none: the name serves a one-paragraph notice

record.interface_detail: The host answers HTML only; there is no API under this domain any more.
record.tooling: An existing Prowlarr or NZBHydra2 entry pointed at scenenzbs.com still resolves, so the old host stays configured and the index is silently lost; the fix is to edit the URL to treasure-maps.com.
record.chaining: Retired in favour of treasure-maps.com; nothing else.

limits.value: the name is retired: every path lands on the mover notice

record.binding_note: The name itself is the constraint: no query reaches an index. The successor record carries the live limits.

identity_cost.detail: Accounts were carried across: 'Your access still works' on the successor site.

record.reliability_note: A rename with no redirect of the API path: an automation client pointed at the old host fails at search time, not at config time.
record.confidence_note: The notice was fetched and the final URL recorded. That the successor is Treasure Maps is the vendor's own sentence.

evidence.proved: 200, final URL https://scenenzbs.com/scenenzbs-moved.html, 45 words: 'We have moved! SceneNZBs is now called Treasure Maps. You can find us at our new address.' with a link to treasure-maps.com
the successor confirms: 'SceneNZBs now sails under a new flag - Treasure Maps. Your access still works.'

record.notes: Inactive indexer domain redirecting to successor service NZB-Life.
